intro: For companies that want their own land and to build at their own pace.
description:
Developed industrial sites from 31,365 m² (3 hectares) to 150,538 m² (15 hectares),
with electrical power, water and natural gas infrastructure, 
fiber-optic readiness (voice and data) and completed exterior access roads.
description2: 8 Industrial Site configurations: the 4 small Industrial Sites are the minimum unit of sale and can be combined to create larger areas; the medium Industrial Sites and the large one can be subdivided. Buying here turns an operating expense into equity: your operation stays where you decide, and the property appreciates along with the corridor.
